New Trading Pairs on XeggeX

Posted on January 2, 2024 | by Editor

Today, XeggeX exchange added 3 new trading pairs for Nerva.

New trading pairs include:

XNV/USDC: https://xeggex.com/market/XNV_USDC

XNV/BTC: https://xeggex.com/market/XNV_BTC

XNV/XPE: https://xeggex.com/market/XNV_XPE

You can still also trade it for Tether:

XNV/USDT: https://xeggex.com/market/XNV_USDT
